# Grappling hook
Press R to fire or release the grappling hook. The grappling hook can pull the player toward rooftops and other high surfaces.

# Walking
WASD moves the player around the arena.

# Jumping and power jump
Space jumps. Power jump starts off each time you spawn. It turns on automatically the first time you leave the castle walls. After that it stays as you set it with Ctrl, even if you go back inside. Ctrl toggles power jump.

# Hovering
Hold Shift while in the air to hover. Hovering consumes hover fuel.

# Weapons and aiming
Left click fires. E cycles weapons. Number keys 1 through 5 select weapons. Right click or C aims.

# Third person camera
P switches between first-person and third-person camera views.

# Talking to your girlfriend
Approach your girlfriend in the gothic house, look at her and press F to talk. She waves when chat opens and moves her hands when replying. Dialogue cannot give quests, move items or change the game world yet.
